details:
The notification system itself in VRC is not that great. It does well around groups and friend requests. But when it comes to notifications about invites and requests. That is where the current issue with the notification system comes. 

The current system does show invites and also requests from other friends. But the problem is that those notifications goes away. Invisible. And there is no other way to check it when afk or sleeping, or distracted other than keeping the VRchat.com open or 3rd party program and checking through the nofications there. Yet a simple refresh or close the page leads into the notifications to dissapear through the VRchat.com website. Also invites and requests tend to dissapear too. Probably because they go to a different world, or they went offline and such. Yet still having a log system is sweet.

I like to know who invites me, who requests me, and who does what. As that can lead to me inviting them later to know whats up and such. But also the curiosity to know who specifically wants to see you or have you around in somewhat shape or form is nice. 

So in the end the leadup question is. Can you make an upgraded Notification System that logs everything by choice your own choice and will. Meaning optional notifications to see there. 

Thank you for listening!
title: Upgraded Notification system
